Whenever I try to plot I get different errors. for instance sometimes I get "Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'input' not found" or another  "Error in FUN(X[[1L]], ...) : only defined on a data frame with all numeric variables". renderPlot does not recognize the Y variables nor the date variable which both are dynamic. I know the ggplot chart is ok because I checked it with the variables I created before passing it on the server.R file.

server.R

library(shiny)
library(moments)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(scales)


set.seed(123)
mat <- as.data.frame(matrix(c(sort(runif(100,1000,5550)),sort(runif(100,15000,32000))),nrow = 40,ncol = 5,byrow = FALSE))
colnames(mat) <- c("cav","lol","tuir","won","amer")
date <- seq(from = as.Date("2014-09-01"),to=as.Date("2014-10-10"),by="day")
mat <- cbind(date=date,mat)
.names <- names(mat)[-1]
.dates <- as.Date(mat$date)

shinyServer(function(input,output){
  
  output$prices <- renderPlot({    
    
    dates <- input$dates
    asset <- subset(mat, .names == input$assets )
    
    g1 <- ggplot(mat,na.rm=TRUE)
    g1 <- g1 + geom_line(aes(dates,asset,colour= "asset"),size=1) +
      scale_x_date(breaks = date_breaks("3 months"),labels = date_format("%b-%y")) +
      theme_economist(dkpanel=TRUE)  + scale_colour_economist() +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n=7), labels=dollar) + 
      theme(legend.position="none") + xlab("date") +
      annotate("text",x=as.Date("2014-09-04"),y=max(asset,na.rm=TRUE),
               color="darkslategray",vjust=-1,size=5,
               label=paste("last price",tail(asset,1),sep="="))
    print(g1)
  })
    
})
